manifest_findings.title: Debug Enabled For App [android:debuggable=true]
manifest_findings.description: Debugging was enabled on the app which makes it easier for reverse engineers to hook a debugger to it. This allows dumping a stack trace and accessing debugging helper classes.

manifest_findings.title: Application Data can be Backed up [android:allowBackup=true]
manifest_findings.description: This flag allows anyone to backup your application data via adb. It allows users who have enabled USB debugging to copy application data off of the device.

manifest_findings.title: Activity (com.android.insecurebankv2.PostLogin) is vulnerable to StrandHogg 2.0
manifest_findings.description: Activity is found to be vulnerable to StrandHogg 2.0 task hijacking vulnerability. When vulnerable, it is possible for other applications to place a malicious activity on top of the activity stack of the vulnerable application. This makes the application an easy target for phishing attacks. The vulnerability can be remediated by setting the launch mode attribute to "singleInstance" and by setting an empty taskAffinity (taskAffinity=""). You can also update the target SDK version (22) of the app to 29 or higher to fix this issue at platform level.

manifest_findings.title: Activity (com.android.insecurebankv2.PostLogin) is not Protected. [android:exported=true]
manifest_findings.description: An Activity is found to be shared with other apps on the device therefore leaving it accessible to any other application on the device.

Application is signed with v1 signature scheme, making it vulnerable to Janus vulnerability on Android 5.0-8.0, if signed only with v1 signature scheme. Applications running on Android 5.0-7.0 signed with v1, and v2/v3 scheme is also vulnerable.

intelligence_report.plain_english_narrative: This application, identified as 'com.android.insecurebankv2', has been found to possess the capability to intercept SMS messages. While its overall risk score is currently low, this specific functionality poses a significant security risk, as it could be exploited to bypass critical banking security controls.
intelligence_report.fraud_objective: SMS interception enabling the theft of One-Time Passwords (OTPs) for unauthorized banking transactions.
intelligence_report.banking_impact_assessment: The capability to intercept SMS messages directly violates the security controls mandated by the RBI Master Direction RBI-MDS-2021, which relies on SMS OTPs for securing banking transactions.
cert_in_recommendations: Per RBI MDS-2021: Immediately isolate device and revoke all banking session tokens
Per CERT-In CIAD-2023-0042: Submit APK hash to CERT-In within 6 hours of detection
recommended_actions: Verify if the SMSInterception capability has been actively exploited on any user devices within our network.
Initiate a dynamic analysis of the application to confirm the SMS interception functionality and identify potential Command and Control (C2) infrastructure.
Alert affected users about the potential risk and advise them to uninstall the application immediately.
intelligence_report.customer_advisory_draft: This application has the ability to read your SMS messages, which could compromise your banking One-Time Passwords (OTPs). We advise you to uninstall this application immediately to protect your financial information.
